name: tabtrack
description: Live task tracking and conversation memory for Claude Code: a per-session [WIP]/[DONE] task line for your statusline, an overview of every live session with /tabtrack:sessions, and daily memos with /tabtrack:memo and /tabtrack:recall.

notifications.title: Desktop notifications
notifications.description: Notify (with the session's current task) when a session waits for input, needs approval, or a background agent finishes.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key (optional)
anthropic_api_key.description: Only if you want summaries generated through the Anthropic API instead of your Claude Code login or a local Ollama model. Sent to api.anthropic.com only.
